items.title: How retail investors can win as crypto rebuilds the financial system
items.summary: Scott Melker and Franklin Templeton EVP and head of digital assets & innovation, Sandy Kaul, discuss how retail investors can participate in the next phase of crypto as the financial system's underlying rails are modernized. They explore the macro trends reshaping digital assets, institutional adoption, and what these changes mean for the future of investing. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Meta is naming its multibillion-dollar AI debt deals after different types of fried dough
items.summary: Meta’s latest corporate bonds earmarked for AI data center spending are called Beignet Investor and Sopaipilla Investor, after two popular sweet treats popular in these states.

items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Could Be 21% Below Fair Value As Dividend Signals Confidence
items.summary: BlackRock dividend declaration and what it means for investors BlackRock (BLK) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $5.73 per share, payable on September 22, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 8, 2026. This payout decision sits alongside a recent $450 million share repurchase tranche and follows BlackRock’s second quarter 2026 earnings report. Together, these actions provide investors with several fresh data points to assess the stock’s income profile...
